"""Stand-alone adversarial tests; all time/counter inputs are SYNTHETIC."""
from __future__ import annotations

import copy
from pathlib import Path
import os
import tempfile
import unittest

import v30_independent_feature_cost_review as v


def fixture():
    arms=[]
    for i,profile in enumerate(v.ARM_ORDER):
        full = i in (0,3)
        vision_ns = 700 if full else 250
        text_ns = 900 + i*10
        cpu_ns = text_ns + vision_ns + 70
        arms.append({'arm':profile,'cpu_ns':cpu_ns,'wall_ns':cpu_ns + 40,
                     'text_items':320,'text_batches':20,
                     'text_cpu_ns':text_ns,'text_wall_ns':text_ns+10,
                     'items':64 if full else 21,'batches':8 if full else 3,
                     'media_bytes_read':4_000_000 if full else 1_200_000,
                     'vision_cpu_ns':vision_ns,'vision_wall_ns':vision_ns+10})
    return {'schema':v.SOURCE_SCHEMA,'authority':'DENY_ALL',
            'disposition':'HOLD_NO_CELL_OR_MODEL_SELECTION',
            'production_authorized':False,'stem_winner_verified':False,
            'frozen_route_plan_sha256':v.MINIMAL_ROUTE_SHA,
            'historical_archive_sha256':v.ORIGINAL_ARCHIVE_SHA,
            'actual_live_text_route_from_model':True,
            'cached_vision_predictions_used_for_route':False,
            'real_test_labels_opened':False,'new_training_updates':0,
            'real_original_source_case_count':64,'selected_vision_cases':21,
            'real_text_model_repo':v.GRANITE[0],
            'real_text_model_revision':v.GRANITE[1],
            'real_vision_model_repo':v.DINO[0],
            'real_vision_model_revision':v.DINO[1],
            'text_model_manifest_sha256':'a'*64,
            'vision_model_manifest_sha256':'b'*64,
            'actual_pretrained_text_and_vision_forwards':True,
            'warmup_text_batches':1,'warmup_vision_batches':1,
            'model_acquisition_and_load_wall_ns':5_000,
            'arm_traces':arms,'text_score_max_abs_drift':0.0,
            'image_feature_max_abs_drift':0.0,
            'process_peak_rss_kib_not_incremental':800_000,
            'energy_joules':None,'gpu_peak_bytes':None,
            'independent_future_windows':0,
            'full_product_end_to_end_savings_proven':False,
            'original_task_accuracy_recomputed_this_run':False,
            'physical_cpu_execution_owner':'original-frozen-granite-and-dinov2'}


class Review(unittest.TestCase):
    def good(self):return v.review(v.canonical(fixture()))
    def deny(self,change):
        model=fixture()
        change(model)
        with self.assertRaises(v.Rejected):v.review(v.canonical(model))

    def test_complete_arms_and_independent_cpu_math(self):
        d=self.good()
        self.assertEqual(d['text_batched_forwards_by_arm'],[20]*4)
        self.assertEqual(d['vision_batched_forwards_by_arm'],[8,3,3,8])
        self.assertEqual(d['full_feature_cpu_ns_by_arm'],[1670,1230,1240,1700])
        self.assertEqual(d['paired_total_feature_cpu_deltas_ns'],[440,460])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(d['combined_total_feature_cpu_reduction_fraction_descriptive'],1-2470/3370)
        self.assertFalse(d['producer_counters_independently_hardware_attested'])
        self.assertFalse(d['production_authorized'])
        self.assertEqual(d['decision'],'HOLD_RESEARCH_FEATURE_CPU_ONLY_NO_PROMOTION')

    def test_no_positive_cost_claim_required(self):
        m=fixture()
        for i in (1,2):
            m['arm_traces'][i]['cpu_ns'] += 1000
            m['arm_traces'][i]['wall_ns'] += 1000
        d=v.review(v.canonical(m))
        self.assertLess(d['combined_total_feature_cpu_reduction_fraction_descriptive'],0)
        self.assertFalse(d['stem_winner_verified'])

    def test_v30_previous_clock_collision_is_rejected(self):
        self.deny(lambda d:d['arm_traces'][0].update(cpu_ns=d['arm_traces'][0]['vision_cpu_ns'],
                                                     wall_ns=d['arm_traces'][0]['vision_wall_ns']))

    def test_text_phase_required_for_every_arm(self):
        self.deny(lambda d:d['arm_traces'][1].__setitem__('text_cpu_ns',d['arm_traces'][1]['cpu_ns']))

    def test_vision_phase_required_for_every_arm(self):
        self.deny(lambda d:d['arm_traces'][1].__setitem__('vision_wall_ns',d['arm_traces'][1]['wall_ns']))

    def test_wrong_count_and_batch_rejected(self):
        self.deny(lambda d:d['arm_traces'][1].__setitem__('batches',8))
        self.deny(lambda d:d['arm_traces'][0].__setitem__('text_batches',0))
        self.deny(lambda d:d['arm_traces'][2].__setitem__('text_items',319))

    def test_wrong_arm_order_rejected(self):
        self.deny(lambda d:d['arm_traces'].__setitem__(slice(0,2),[d['arm_traces'][1],d['arm_traces'][0]]))
        self.deny(lambda d:d['arm_traces'].pop())

    def test_dropped_phase_clock_is_rejected(self):
        self.deny(lambda d:d['arm_traces'][0].pop('vision_cpu_ns'))
        self.deny(lambda d:d['arm_traces'][0].pop('text_cpu_ns'))

    def test_wrong_repeated_media_bytes_rejected(self):
        self.deny(lambda d:d['arm_traces'][0].__setitem__('media_bytes_read',42))

    def test_wrong_original_model_revision_rejected(self):
        self.deny(lambda d:d.__setitem__('real_text_model_revision','0'*40))
        self.deny(lambda d:d.__setitem__('real_vision_model_revision','0'*40))

    def test_model_manifest_identity_rejected(self):
        self.deny(lambda d:d.__setitem__('text_model_manifest_sha256','no verification'))
        self.deny(lambda d:d.__setitem__('vision_model_manifest_sha256','a'*64))

    def test_wrong_source_or_route_rejected(self):
        self.deny(lambda d:d.__setitem__('historical_archive_sha256','f'*64))
        self.deny(lambda d:d.__setitem__('frozen_route_plan_sha256','f'*64))

    def test_missing_or_forged_labeled_outcome_rejected(self):
        self.deny(lambda d:d.__setitem__('real_test_labels_opened',True))
        self.deny(lambda d:d.__setitem__('cached_vision_predictions_used_for_route',True))
        self.deny(lambda d:d.__setitem__('independent_future_windows',1))
        self.deny(lambda d:d.__setitem__('original_task_accuracy_recomputed_this_run',True))

    def test_authority_and_physical_claim_veto(self):
        self.deny(lambda d:d.__setitem__('authority','GRANTED'))
        self.deny(lambda d:d.__setitem__('production_authorized',True))
        self.deny(lambda d:d.__setitem__('full_product_end_to_end_savings_proven',True))
        self.deny(lambda d:d.__setitem__('actual_pretrained_text_and_vision_forwards',False))

    def test_boolean_counter_is_not_one(self):
        self.deny(lambda d:d.__setitem__('warmup_text_batches',True))
        self.deny(lambda d:d['arm_traces'][0].__setitem__('text_batches',True))

    def test_unknown_authority_field_rejected(self):
        self.deny(lambda d:d.__setitem__('FinalUseGranted',True))
        self.deny(lambda d:d['arm_traces'][0].__setitem__('token', 'secret'))

    def test_nonfinite_and_overflow_rejected(self):
        for x in (float('nan'),float('inf'),True,-1):
            try: raw=v.canonical(dict(fixture(),text_score_max_abs_drift=x))
            except ValueError:continue
            with self.assertRaises(v.Rejected):v.review(raw)
        self.deny(lambda d:d['arm_traces'][0].__setitem__('cpu_ns',10**35))

    def test_duplicate_json_field_denied(self):
        raw=v.canonical(fixture())
        altered=raw.replace(b'"authority":"DENY_ALL"',
                            b'"authority":"DENY_ALL","authority":"GRANTED"')
        with self.assertRaises(v.Rejected):v.review(altered)

    def test_noncanoical_and_oversize_denied(self):
        raw=v.canonical(fixture())
        for payload in (raw[:-1],b' '+raw, raw+b' ',b'{}\n',b'x'*v.MAX_REPORT_BYTES+b'\n'):
            with self.subTest(size=len(payload)),self.assertRaises(v.Rejected):v.review(payload)

    def test_strict_create_only_output(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as name:
            p=Path(name)/'readonly-review.json'
            d=self.good()
            v.write_create_only(p,d)
            self.assertEqual(p.read_bytes(),v.canonical(d))
            self.assertEqual(p.stat().st_mode & 0o777,0o600)
            with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):v.write_create_only(p,d)

    def test_yaml_separate_review_consumer(self):
        root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
        wf=(root/'.github/workflows/hepta-stem-v30-live-text-vision.yml').read_text()
        self.assertIn('  independent-feature-cost-review:',wf)
        self.assertIn('needs: original-physical-live-text-vision',wf)
        self.assertIn('download-artifact@v4',wf)
        self.assertIn('v30_independent_feature_cost_review.py',wf)
        self.assertIn('producer',wf)
        self.assertIn('DENY_ALL',wf)
        self.assertIn('stem-v30-live-text-vision-cost-hold-${{ github.sha }}',wf)

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()

# V30 — original Granite text–route–DINO physical feature-cost comparison

2026-10-17 · **DRAFT / SHADOW_ONLY / DENY_ALL**. Additive study on frozen V29
`b60f54d7835a07808e0dd81e3f7f5d3b8ad4c71e`. No selected model,
Neuron runtime, shared-memory/caches, NDU ownership, CAS/CNS, final-use,
Cell split or `main` change.

## Why the earlier result cannot answer full shared-Stem economics

V28 physically ran **only** the frozen DINO image Encoder, with a historical
precomputed text-margin route requesting 21/64 original image features. Original
physical same-host CPU evidence was average ~5.48 s for 64 vs ~1.78 s for 21
image encodes; this is a useful **vision-only** cost reduction, not an end-to-end
Hepta or text+vision speedup. V25/V27 independent retrospective same-source
accuracy remained 17/64 for both text and frozen conditional (5 rescues/5 harms,
McNemar p=1). V29 stripped precomputed image class values from the model-facing
route but retained **historical** text-derived triggering. Thus no deployed
real-time text -> image execution or additional accuracy gain was proven.

## Physical new experiment and exact source identities

The research model process accepts **only** the exact V29 source-only route
`d8a555bef8f95680cd35a16cf3dbe7f8e9ab717fe626e4dc82e6fd61538773a6`,
original publisher source
`a561916c7d56b6677c5511c329a49bbeec94879f019d29f159ff59be83359202`,
and pinned original ScienceQA media. It is not given TEST labels, full original
V27 plan, cached image classes, prediction archive, per-case outputs, or
historical probability vectors.

- Original 192-source-group ScienceQA-IMG publisher revision
  `b9984af01798586705cee1fbdfa80a6dcbef04f1` via reviewed predictor-source-only
  stager commit `751ab11dcb7ff3c20d895c698633e7b2d5ada2b8`.
- Frozen text model: original Granite97
  `ibm-granite/granite-embedding-97m-multilingual-r2` at
  `835ad14087e140460703cf0fae09f97d469d65c2`; one verified shared instance.
- Frozen image model: original DINOv2-small `facebook/dinov2-small` at
  `ed25f3a31f01632728cabb09d1542f84ab7b0056`; one verified shared instance.
- Source-bound original E3 encoder and verification code from
  `b8b2f10fe38506972301e77e3836729a90200673`, with transitive audited
  LocalEncoder imports separately fetched and checked against immutable Git blobs.
  Neither model may silently load random/meta tensors, reinterpret Laya's decision
  Head, or download different weights on error.

**Each ABBA arm** (full64, conditional21, conditional21, full64) begins by
physically encoding the **same 64 questions and four original choices per case**,
320 strings in exactly 20 observed Granite forward batches (max 16 prompts).
It normalizes Granite 384D CLS features exactly as original E3, forms
question/choice dot products, applies the original fixed ×8 softmax, and computes
`top1 - top2 < 0.005` entirely from the fresh text score. The historical V29
`trigger_vision` bit is a fail-closed *post-inference conformance check*, never
training target or model feature; every one of 64 bits must match or the
experiment stops without a positive receipt. The image Encoder then physically
processes either all 64 original test media (8 batches) or only those 21 selected
by the freshly computed text policy (3 batches). Each repeat independently
recomputes text features; no cache silently gives selective arms free text CPU.

Record separate text CPU/wall, image CPU/wall, combined input-to-feature
CPU/wall, true backend batch counts, image media bytes read, physical saved
model manifests/revisions, one-time acquisition/load wall time, separate
TRAIN-only warmup, and *process* high-water RSS. Compare both selected image
features and entire repeated text choice-probability tensors for numeric parity
<=1e-4 (descriptive tolerance, not a semantic accuracy threshold). Published
readout is sanitized aggregate only; it has no prompts, image data, model weights,
source IDs, probability arrays, choices or private labels. GPU bytes and energy
remain explicit NULL.

## Model-side source and label controls

Full original E3 archive is SHA-256 checked, its V27 full plan is sealed, and
V29 reduced route is checked **before original model or media acquisition**.
The archive and full plan are removed before any model run. An independent
fixed SHA source stager writes only source rows, media and TRAIN/CAL fit labels;
those unnecessary fit-label bytes are first verified, **then removed before V30
model launch**. TEST label callback/bytes/hash are absent in predictor-source-only
mode. Publisher HF cache is deleted before the model stage. No job shell sets
`HELD_SHA`; runtime rejects label environment variables or private label folder.

The existing source contract tests remain, plus V30 source-only tests for
route identity, exact 21/64, label/unknown class rejection, missing/mutated
model scores, missing/fabricated backend calls, four text inference repetitions,
selected image parity, and SHA-pinned transitive original Python model loaders.
`test_v30_live_text_vision.py` uses **synthetic controls only** and never pretends
to have executed pretrained weights. Hosted real-model execution is **push-only**
after this source gate succeeds; absence of a completed physical run is
`UNQUALIFIED`, not evidence of an achieved speedup.

## Scientific hard gates and intended interpretation

This experiment may establish the original **feature ingestion** CPU savings
when both text and image pretrained models are live and physically selected,
under one same-host warm-loaded research process. It **cannot** establish full
Hepta run latency or RSS *savings*: training, task/Head selection, task-result
accuracy, NDU selection, CAS/authority, checkpoint/recovery, GPU, energy,
front-end queues, privacy-protected multi-principal serving, negative transfer,
and prospective future-window utility are outside this scope. Process maximum
RSS is not a per-arm resident-delta measurement. In particular even a
successful V30 does not repair the frozen **negative** V25/V27 17/64 accuracy
finding. Do not change `main`, production models, selected Stem, FinalUse,
CNS, or Cell topology based on this study.

## V30 exact-source correction: distinct total/text/vision clocks and independent postseal audit

The first V30 source commit constructed each arm trace as
`{'cpu_ns': combined, 'wall_ns': combined, **text_obs, **image_obs}`.
Because the image phase also names `cpu_ns` and `wall_ns`, Python dictionary
unpacking overwrote the combined total with **DINO-only** measurements. This is a
real scientific-integrity bug in the original report emission; existing V30
source tests did not catch it. Any physical report emitted by that uncorrected
source is **not** valid combined text+vision CPU evidence, even if its visual
batch counts or test job were successful.

The corrected V30 source retains `cpu_ns` / `wall_ns` for the entire
source-to-feature run, `text_cpu_ns` / `text_wall_ns` for the repeated original
Granite text phase, and new `vision_cpu_ns` / `vision_wall_ns` for the actual
DINO phase, with `cpu_ns >= text_cpu_ns + vision_cpu_ns` and an analogous wall
time bound. `items`, `batches` and `media_bytes_read` remain the physically
observed visual counts so the existing forward-count ABI stays unchanged.
A positive cost ratio is NOT hardcoded: slower conditional feature execution
must be reported as a negative saving, not forced into an apparent win.

The new independent read-only `v30_independent_feature_cost_review.py` runs in a
**separate Actions job**, consuming only the previous exact-push sanitized
physical-model artifact. It checks exact source/route/model identity,
ABBA inventory, every text and visual forward count, three disjoint phase
clocks, media byte repeat parity, calibration/feature drift, and 
`DENY_ALL`. It independently recomputes two paired total CPU deltas and the
aggregate descriptive ratio; it never loads pretrained weights or heldout
labels. Missing model job artifact, impossible clocks, changed source/model,
unknown fields, fabricated performance telemetry or incomplete original
features fail closed. A missing/failed model job blocks the auditor rather
than being replaced by synthetic fixtures.

A separate CPU evidence consumer can check **arithmetic consistency**, but
reading a model-generated JSON is NOT an external, cryptographically trusted
physical runner attestation. Consequently it writes
`producer_counters_independently_hardware_attested=false` and cannot issue
scientific promotion, NDU selection, user effects, FinalUse or Cell Split.
All source/authoring test outcomes and new Actions check results must be tied
to the exact corrected commit SHA. Existing older CI runs cannot validate it.

name: Hepta Stem V30 live Granite text and conditional DINO CPU (DENY_ALL)

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "qualification/stem-cell-v1/v28_physical_lazy_vision.py"
      - "qualification/stem-cell-v1/v29_route_only.py"
      - "qualification/stem-cell-v1/v30_live_text_vision.py"
      - "qualification/stem-cell-v1/test_v28_physical_lazy_vision.py"
      - "qualification/stem-cell-v1/test_v30_live_text_vision.py"
      - "qualification/stem-cell-v1/v30_independent_feature_cost_review.py"
      - "qualification/stem-cell-v1/test_v30_independent_feature_cost_review.py"
      - "qualification/stem-cell-v1/STEM_V30_LIVE_TEXT_COST_20261017.md"
      - ".github/workflows/hepta-stem-v30-live-text-vision.yml"
  push:
    branches:
      - research/stem-v30-live-text-vision-20261017
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: stem-v30-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  source-contract:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - name: Exact-head standalone adversarial tests (no pretrained/model claim)
        working-directory: qualification/stem-cell-v1
        env:
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HEAD_SHA"
          python -m py_compile v28_physical_lazy_vision.py v29_route_only.py v30_live_text_vision.py v30_independent_feature_cost_review.py test_v28_physical_lazy_vision.py test_v30_live_text_vision.py test_v30_independent_feature_cost_review.py
          python -m unittest -v test_v28_physical_lazy_vision test_v30_live_text_vision test_v30_independent_feature_cost_review
          python -O -m unittest -v test_v28_physical_lazy_vision test_v30_live_text_vision test_v30_independent_feature_cost_review

  original-physical-live-text-vision:
    # Research weights and publisher bytes are acquired on push only, never on PR.
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_name == 'research/stem-v30-live-text-vision-20261017' && github.repository == 'TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci'
    needs: source-contract
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Freeze source-only V29 policy identity before ANY physical text/vision access
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EXACT_HEAD: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          umask 077
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXACT_HEAD"
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/artifacts/11945106672/zip" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/original-e3.zip"
          echo "7807b82d6c747b0b13666b330145e3801a8c8a0aadeee3f2ff7ab5f5c8c00a30  $RUNNER_TEMP/original-e3.zip" | sha256sum -c -
          python qualification/stem-cell-v1/v27_conditional_vision_replay.py seal \
            --archive "$RUNNER_TEMP/original-e3.zip" --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/private-v29-full-plan.json"
          echo "c8f3f3d03ef9bdc9722d1197aaa807d901a4d5cda2e6c40d20f8ddcf7d2b8ad2  $RUNNER_TEMP/private-v29-full-plan.json" | sha256sum -c -
          # Publish a strictly reduced, label-free AND image-output-free plan.
          # The physical model never receives precomputed image predictions.
          python qualification/stem-cell-v1/v29_route_only.py \
            --full-plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/private-v29-full-plan.json" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/v29-model-only-route.json"
          echo "d8a555bef8f95680cd35a16cf3dbe7f8e9ab717fe626e4dc82e6fd61538773a6  $RUNNER_TEMP/v29-model-only-route.json" | sha256sum -c -
          rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/private-v29-full-plan.json"
          # The scorer archive and its historical target digest are NOT inputs
          # to the real model process; only precommitted route identity survives.
          rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/original-e3.zip"
      - name: Obtain byte-exact original model/source and target-isolated E3 stager
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          umask 077
          test -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/v29-model-only-route.json"
          test ! -e "$RUNNER_TEMP/private-v29-full-plan.json"
          mkdir -m 700 "$RUNNER_TEMP/verified-e3-modules"
          fetch_pinned () {
            local commit="$1" source_path="$2" expected_blob="$3"
            local destination="$RUNNER_TEMP/verified-e3-modules/${source_path##*/}"
            gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/contents/$source_path?ref=$commit" --jq '.content' | base64 --decode > "$destination"
            test "$(git hash-object "$destination")" = "$expected_blob"
            chmod 0400 "$destination"
          }
          # Historical actual DINO loader, validated snapshot owner and E3 contract.
          fetch_pinned b8b2f10fe38506972301e77e3836729a90200673 experiments/shared_stem_cell/e3_scienceqa_contract.py bd6d95ff957c3855b71a8778d7c13f61ff4d6a7a
          fetch_pinned b8b2f10fe38506972301e77e3836729a90200673 experiments/shared_stem_cell/e3_granite_dino_real.py b99c99d8e13a4d1899a0597d7733753fb3ce092a
          fetch_pinned b8b2f10fe38506972301e77e3836729a90200673 experiments/shared_stem_cell/execution.py 733da82a4bbbde1b256dfd1dbe4c05832dcd4856
          # LocalEncoder's original audited, strictly pinned transitive imports.
          # Omitting these would make a DINO-only smoke pass but live-text load fail.
          fetch_pinned b8b2f10fe38506972301e77e3836729a90200673 experiments/shared_stem_cell/multimodal_saved_tie_recovery_v18.py 27839fbeb9402e8afeb1f2a23288006146757a53
          fetch_pinned b8b2f10fe38506972301e77e3836729a90200673 experiments/shared_stem_cell/multimodal_meta_integrity_v14.py d562d7e5c518a1f194c0f026968e8d64e996c527
          fetch_pinned b8b2f10fe38506972301e77e3836729a90200673 experiments/shared_stem_cell/multimodal_exact_tied_alias_v11.py f4ec7f415c6dc3f51a965c603eb96339d908413c
          fetch_pinned b8b2f10fe38506972301e77e3836729a90200673 experiments/shared_stem_cell/multimodal_native_pool_v7.py b3d54cec40c82d51457925f2a2113566cd8f1c6c
          # Later reviewed source-target split; never invoke TEST callback in predictor mode.
          fetch_pinned 751ab11dcb7ff3c20d895c698633e7b2d5ada2b8 experiments/shared_stem_cell/e3_scienceqa_stage.py 7fa6adc26a76dfcc644c748259a4a8ca8d04f99e

  independent-feature-cost-review:
    # Separate process/job from the original physical model owner, and no
    # predictor files, private labels, source media or checkpoint weights.
    needs: original-physical-live-text-vision
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_name == 'research/stem-v30-live-text-vision-20261017' && github.repository == 'TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          # Only the producer artifact from THIS exact push run is eligible.
          name: stem-v30-live-text-vision-cost-hold-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/v30-producer
      - name: Independently recount both model phases and reject V30 clock collision
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          umask 077
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
          python -m unittest -q test_v30_independent_feature_cost_review
        working-directory: qualification/stem-cell-v1
      - name: Generate independent read-only original feature-cost audit
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          umask 077
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
          test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/v30-producer/v30-physical-descriptive-HOLD.json"
          python qualification/stem-cell-v1/v30_independent_feature_cost_review.py \
            --producer "$RUNNER_TEMP/v30-producer/v30-physical-descriptive-HOLD.json" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/v30-independent-numerical-HOLD.json"
          python - <<'PY_CHECK'
          import json,os
          from pathlib import Path
          result=json.loads((Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'v30-independent-numerical-HOLD.json').read_text())
          assert result['decision']=='HOLD_RESEARCH_FEATURE_CPU_ONLY_NO_PROMOTION'
          assert result['numerical_receipt_recounted'] is True
          assert result['producer_counters_independently_hardware_attested'] is False
          assert result['actual_accuracy_or_future_utility_verified'] is False
          assert result['production_authorized'] is False
          assert result['text_batched_forwards_by_arm']==[20]*4
          assert result['vision_batched_forwards_by_arm']==[8,3,3,8]
          print('Independent feature-cost arithmetic only; model authority DENY_ALL')
          PY_CHECK
      - name: Publish numerical audit only, no predictor artifact or private data
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: stem-v30-independent-feature-cost-hold-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/v30-independent-numerical-HOLD.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
